elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires TrueLink to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires an aggregate limit of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(b) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The condition applies because Section 31(c) expressly identifies TrueLink's processing of Client Content and other Client data. It requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering that processing.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 31(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The final sentence requires TrueLink to provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing the required coverage upon request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(b) requires USD 2,000,000 of professional liability coverage, exceeding the USD 1,000,000 fallback.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The processing condition applies because Section 31(c) expressly identifies processing of Client Content and other Client data. The required USD 5,000,000 cyber and privacy limit exceeds the USD 2,000,000 fallback.

result.reason: The operative insurance clause meets every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds both fallback limits. It is appropriately directed to TrueLink, applies throughout the agreement term, and includes the requested certificate trigger. The addition is confined to implementing the insurance requirement and does not alter the force-majeure terms or introduce a contradiction. Drafting is clear, though the unchanged force-majeure clause contains the apparent typo “control or TrueLink,” which reduces overall drafting quality.
